"""Developer-only harmonic boundary color diagnostic; no production integration."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from scipy.sparse.linalg import cg
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'product/src'))
from ai_ad_editor.runtime import configure_local_runtime
from ai_ad_editor.media import ffmpeg_path
configure_local_runtime()
base=root/'workspace/vace-smoke-calibration-20261016-controlled-v1'
out=root/'workspace/vace-smoke-harmonic-diagnostic-20261016'
assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
previous=json.loads((root/'workspace/vace-smoke-20261016-controlled-v2/summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def decode(path):
 raw=subprocess.run([ffmpeg_path(),'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-i',str(path),'-an','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgba','pipe:1'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
 return np.frombuffer(raw,np.uint8).reshape(8,128,192,4)
source=decode(previous['inpainting']['source']['path']);mask=decode(previous['inpainting']['mask']['path']);selected=mask[:,:,:,3]>127.5
truth_path=root/'product/.runtime/fixtures/lama-20261016-reproduced/ground-truth.npz';truth=np.load(truth_path,allow_pickle=False)['frames']
def correct(src,generated,chosen):
 h,w=chosen.shape;ys,xs=np.nonzero(chosen);n=len(ys)
 if not n:return generated.copy(),{'empty':True}
 assert n<h*w and n<=100000
 index=np.full((h,w),-1,np.int32);index[ys,xs]=np.arange(n)
 rows=[];cols=[];values=[];rhs=np.zeros((n,3),np.float64);degree=np.zeros(n,np.float64)
 g=generated[:,:,:3].astype(np.float64)
 for dy,dx in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
  valid=(ys+dy>=0)&(ys+dy<h)&(xs+dx>=0)&(xs+dx<w)
  at=np.flatnonzero(valid);qy=ys[at]+dy;qx=xs[at]+dx;neighbor=index[qy,qx];degree[at]+=1
  interior=neighbor>=0;rows.extend(at[interior]);cols.extend(neighbor[interior]);values.extend([-1.]*int(interior.sum()))
  at=at[~interior];qy=qy[~interior];qx=qx[~interior]
  # Boundary errors use source outside selection and extrapolate model colors from inside only.
  gy=g[ys[at],xs[at]].copy();by=ys[at]-dy;bx=xs[at]-dx
  back=(by>=0)&(by<h)&(bx>=0)&(bx<w);take=np.flatnonzero(back)
  valid_back=np.zeros(len(at),bool);valid_back[take]=chosen[by[take],bx[take]]
  take=np.flatnonzero(valid_back);gy[take]+=gy[take]-g[by[take],bx[take]]
  rhs[at]+=src[qy,qx,:3].astype(np.float64)-gy
 rows.extend(range(n));cols.extend(range(n));values.extend(degree)
 matrix=csr_matrix((values,(rows,cols)),shape=(n,n));correction=np.zeros((n,3),np.float64);iterations=[]
 for c in range(3):
  count=[0]
  def progress(_):count[0]+=1
  correction[:,c],status=cg(matrix,rhs[:,c],rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-7,maxiter=2000,callback=progress)
  assert status==0,status;iterations.append(count[0])
 value=generated.copy();value[ys,xs,:3]=np.rint(np.clip(g[ys,xs]+correction,0,255)).astype(np.uint8)
 assert np.array_equal(value[~chosen],generated[~chosen]);assert np.array_equal(value[:,:,3],generated[:,:,3])
 return value,{'selected_pixels':n,'iterations':iterations,'max_abs_correction':float(np.abs(correction).max())}
meta={'scope':'Developer-only spatial harmonic boundary correction on saved model outputs, not CLI integration, model improvement, temporal reconstruction or broad quality acceptance.',
 'source_sha256':previous['source_sha256'],'decoded_mask_sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(mask.tobytes()).hexdigest(),'truth_sha256':sha(truth_path),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'cases':[],'broad_quality_accepted':False}
views=[('truth',truth)];started=time.monotonic()
for name in ['native-shift3-30','4x-shift16-30']:
 original=np.load(base/(name+'.npy'),allow_pickle=False);frames=[];records=[]
 for i in range(8):
  corrected,record=correct(source[i],original[i],selected[i]);frames.append(corrected);records.append(record)
 result=np.stack(frames);errors=(result[:,:,:,:3].astype(np.float64)-truth[:,:,:,:3].astype(np.float64))[selected];mse=float((errors**2).mean());psnr=float(10*np.log10(255**2/mse)) if mse else 100.
 assert not np.any(np.any(result[:,:,:,:3]!=source[:,:,:,:3],axis=3)&~selected);assert np.array_equal(result[:,:,:,3],source[:,:,:,3])
 target=out/(name+'.npy');np.save(target,result,allow_pickle=False);meta['cases'].append({'id':name,'input_sha256':sha(base/(name+'.npy')),'output_sha256':sha(target),'masked_psnr_db':psnr,'outside_changed_pixels':0,'alpha_exact':True,'frames':records})
 views.extend([(name,original),('harmonic '+name,result)])
width,height,label=288,192,22;sheet=Image.new('RGB',(width*len(views),(height+label)*3),'#20232a');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for row,i in enumerate([3,4,7]):
 for col,(name,value) in enumerate(views):
  x=col*width;y=row*(height+label);sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(value[i,:,:,:3]).resize((width,height)),(x,y+label));draw.text((x+4,y+4),name+' / '+str(i),fill='white')
sheet.save(out/'contact.png');meta['contact']={'path':(out/'contact.png').relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(out/'contact.png')};meta['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'cases':[{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k in ['id','masked_psnr_db']} for c in meta['cases']],'elapsed_seconds':meta['elapsed_seconds'],'contact':meta['contact']},ensure_ascii=False))

"""Developer natural-scene review of harmonic color correction; sampled frames only."""
import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1';os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='1';os.environ['MKL_NUM_THREADS']='1'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFilter,ImageOps
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from scipy.sparse.linalg import cg
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'product/src'))
from ai_ad_editor.runtime import configure_local_runtime
from ai_ad_editor.media import ffmpeg_path
configure_local_runtime()
def sha(p):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
probe=root/'product/.runtime/vace_harmonic_probe_20261016.py'
previous=json.loads((root/'workspace/vace-smoke-harmonic-diagnostic-20261016/summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));assert sha(probe)==previous['driver_sha256']
node=next(n for n in ast.parse(probe.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='correct')
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[])),str(probe),'exec'),globals())
summary_path=root/'workspace/vace-smoke-20261016-natural-v2/summary.json';summary=json.loads(summary_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));result=summary['inpainting']
height,width,frames=(result['video'][k] for k in ['height','width','frames'])
def decode(path):
 raw=subprocess.run([ffmpeg_path(),'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-i',str(path),'-an','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgba','pipe:1'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
 return np.frombuffer(raw,np.uint8).reshape(frames,height,width,4)
source=decode(result['source']['path']);mask=decode(result['mask']['path']);generated=decode(result['output'])
selected=mask[:,:,:,3]>result['inpainting']['threshold']*255;grow=result['inpainting']['grow']
selected=np.array([np.asarray(Image.fromarray(v.astype(np.uint8)*255).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(grow*2+1)))!=0 for v in selected])
lama_summary=json.loads((root/'workspace/lama-smoke-20261016-vace-matched-natural/summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));lama=decode(lama_summary['inpainting']['output'])
indices=[0,4,8,12,13,16,17,21,25,26,29,30,31];out=root/'workspace/vace-smoke-harmonic-natural-diagnostic-20261016';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
started=time.monotonic();records=[];outputs=[]
for i in indices:
 value,record=correct(source[i],generated[i],selected[i]);outputs.append(value)
 assert np.array_equal(value[:,:,3],source[i,:,:,3]);assert not np.any(np.any(value[:,:,:3]!=source[i,:,:,:3],axis=2)&~selected[i])
 records.append({'source_frame':i,**record});print(json.dumps({'frame':i,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)
# The source pixels being removed must not participate in boundary estimation.
i=indices[0];altered=source[i].copy();altered[selected[i],:3]=[255,0,0];changed,_=correct(altered,generated[i],selected[i]);assert np.array_equal(changed,outputs[0])
np.save(out/'sampled-outputs.npy',np.stack(outputs),allow_pickle=False)
views=[('source',source[indices]),('VACE',generated[indices]),('harmonic diagnostic',np.stack(outputs)),('matched LaMa',lama[indices])];contacts=[]
for sheetno,offset in enumerate(range(0,len(indices),7),1):
 chosen=indices[offset:offset+7];cw,ch,label=352,198,22;sheet=Image.new('RGB',(cw*len(views),(ch+label)*len(chosen)),'#20232a');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
 for row,frameindex in enumerate(chosen):
  for col,(name,value) in enumerate(views):
   x,y=col*cw,row*(ch+label);pic=ImageOps.contain(Image.fromarray(value[offset+row,:,:,:3]),(cw,ch));sheet.paste(pic,(x+(cw-pic.width)//2,y+label+(ch-pic.height)//2));draw.text((x+4,y+4),name+' / '+str(frameindex),fill='white')
 target=out/('contact-'+str(sheetno)+'.png');sheet.save(target);contacts.append({'path':target.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(target),'frame_indices':chosen})
meta={'scope':'Developer-only sampled natural video diagnostics; no hidden truth, model rerun, production integration or temporal/broad quality acceptance.','driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'boundary_algorithm_sha256':sha(probe),'source_summary_sha256':sha(summary_path),
 'source_sha256':summary['source_sha256'],'frame_indices':indices,'source_selected_rgb_perturbation_invariant':True,'source_alpha_exact':True,'outside_mask_changed_pixels':0,'frames':records,'contacts':contacts,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'broad_quality_accepted':False,'continuous_playback_reviewed':False}
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n');print(json.dumps({'elapsed_seconds':meta['elapsed_seconds'],'contacts':contacts},ensure_ascii=False))
